title: DEF Dosing Unit Open Circuit
shortDescription: AGCO Power dosing valve circuit open.
fullDescription:
Massey Ferguson 7700, 8700, and 6700S series with AGCO Power engines and SCR-only e3 aftertreatment. SPN 3361 FMI 5 indicates dosing valve solenoid open.

Derate ladder applies if uncorrected.

fixSteps.title: Connect EDT diagnostic tool
fixSteps.instruction: AGCO EDT Pro to read codes.

fixSteps.title: Replace dosing valve
fixSteps.instruction: Drain DEF lines, swap unit with new gasket.

faq.a: Yes, AGCO Power is the rebranded Sisu Diesel.

title: DEF Tank Level Low
fullDescription: Refill with ISO 22241 DEF promptly. Inducement ladder begins after extended low level.

faq.a: Roughly 5 percent of fuel consumption rate.

title: Cylinder 1 Injector Open Circuit
fullDescription: AGCO Power common rail injector failure. Replace and program trim code via EDT.

fixSteps.title: Replace injector and program trim code

faq.a: Yes, AGCO Power 7.4L is inline 6 with individual injectors.

title: Coolant Temperature High
fullDescription: Plugged screens, low coolant, or thermostat failure. Cleaning radiator screen typically resolves.

faq.a: Some 8700S have reverser fan via Datatronic settings.

title: Fuel Delivery Pressure Low
fullDescription: Plugged filters and air leaks are typical on AGCO Power. Replace filters and prime.

faq.a: Yes - bulk farm tanks need biocide every 6 months.

title: Engine Oil Pressure Low
fullDescription: Auto shutdown will protect engine. Check oil first, then sender.

title: Lost Communication With Transmission Controller
fullDescription: Dyna-VT or Dyna-7 transmission communication lost. Check CAN harness and terminating resistors.

faq.a: Sometimes triggers parallel hydraulic codes; diagnose CAN first.

title: DPF Differential Pressure High
fullDescription: Some MF models with SCR + DPF require parked regen. SCR-only e3 models do not have DPF.

faq.a: No, e3 SCR-only models skip the DPF.

title: Hydraulic System Pressure Not Responding
shortDescription: Hydraulic pump not building commanded pressure.
fullDescription: Massey Ferguson load-sensing hydraulic system. Contaminated oil and stuck compensator are common.

title: Engine Protection Derate Active
shortDescription: Engine in protection mode from upstream fault.
fullDescription: Generic protection trigger. Check parallel codes for the actual root cause - often plugged air filter, fuel restriction, or DEF inducement.

fixSteps.title: Address root fault
fixSteps.instruction: Repair DEF, fuel, or sensor issue.

faq.a: Yes after root cause fixed and key cycle.
